run_single_point_orca_calculation: run a single-point ORCA energy calculation on an Atoms object with a specified functional and basis set
run_ase_relaxation_orca: run an ASE geometry optimization using ORCA with customizable optimizer parameters and process count
run_single_point_with_nbo: run a single-point ORCA calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled for the given molecule
run_ase_relaxation_with_restart: run an ASE relaxation job with a custom step counter start index for optimization restarts
run_single_point_metal_organics: run a single-point ORCA calculation with symmetry breaking for metal-organic systems using UKS
